description: Crypto options implied volatility (Deribit): DVOL index with 1y percentile, ATM IV term structure (7/30/90d) and inversion, 25-delta risk reversal and butterfly per expiry, 30d IV vs realized volatility, spot–vol correlation, 24h/7d skew and term changes, and the implied 1σ move for 1/7/30 days — how fast a move options price, not its direction. Pass several underlyings ("BTC,ETH") to compare.

currency.description: Underlying symbol or comma-separated list (max 4), e.g. "BTC" or "BTC,ETH".

name: options_volatility

reads.description: One read per underlying that answered, in the order requested

atmIv.description: Constant-maturity ATM implied volatility, percent annualized (calculated)

changes.description: Changes of the vol state vs stored hourly snapshots; empty before any snapshot exists

iv30dChange.description: Change of 30d ATM IV, vol points

riskReversal25Change.description: Change of the 25-delta risk reversal, vol points

termSlopeChange.description: Change of the term slope, vol points

dvol.description: DVOL, the venue's reported 30-day implied-volatility index; absent when unavailable

at.description: Time of that value, ISO 8601 UTC

changeVsPriorDay.description: Change vs the previous daily close, vol points

percentile.description: Percentile of the current value against about a year of daily closes, 0–100

expiries.description: Per-expiry volatility surface summary, nearest first

butterfly25.description: 25-delta wing average minus ATM IV, vol points

forwardUsd.description: Forward price the venue priced the expiry off, USD

riskReversal25.description: 25-delta call IV minus put IV, vol points

impliedMovePct.description: Implied 1σ move over each horizon, how fast the market prices a move, not its direction

extrapolated.description: True when the horizon is shorter than the front expiry and front IV was used

meta.description: Provenance of the snapshot the numbers come from

ageSeconds.description: Seconds between the observation and this response

observedAt.description: When the venue snapshot was observed, ISO 8601 UTC

notes.description: Data caveats, e.g. a DVOL or candle source that failed

realized30d.description: 30d realized volatility from daily closes, percent annualized (calculated)

riskReversal25At30d.description: 25-delta risk reversal at 30d, call IV minus put IV, vol points (calculated)

skewState.description: PUTS OVER CALLS | CALLS OVER PUTS | NEUTRAL | UNAVAILABLE

spotVolCorrelation90d.description: Correlation of daily DVOL change with daily log return over the last 90 days, −1 to 1 (calculated)

termSlope7dMinus30d.description: 7d ATM IV minus 30d ATM IV, vol points

volPremium.description: 30d ATM IV minus 30d realized, vol points

unavailable.description: Underlyings that failed, with the reason

title: Options Volatility
